findings.text: blocking: _pass_verdict_record and _record_pass_verdicts require landed or obligations and ignore skipped, so a pass whose only landing outcome is landed-elsewhere writes no verdict row despite the node's explicit durable-record requirement.

blocking: The pointer may disappear after the final _landed_elsewhere read but before _record_attempt writes attempting; that CrewError is outside the new catch and becomes the landing stage error the change promises to avoid.
